machine: AMD Ryzen 7 7700X (8 cores, 16 threads), Windows 11, preset msvc-release
notes: Gates for CTest bench.<suite> (bench/se_bench/CMakeLists.txt reads n, iterations, warmup and p95_ms). Thresholds hold for Release builds on this machine; other machines are pending gates (docs/gates.md).

renderlist_10k.source: M3 exit gate: RenderList of 10k sprites, p95 <= 1 ms in Release (docs/milestone-specs.md M3c)

measured.note: Ranges over 5 runs of 1000 warm iterations (7556 of 10000 sprites visible, 32 batches) while other builds shared the machine; the p99 and max outliers are that load.

render_frame_10k.source: M7 exit gate: RenderList plus sprite vertices of 10k visible sprites, CPU side, p95 <= 1 ms in Release (docs/milestone-specs.md M7, Bench)

measured.note: Not idle: other agents' parallel builds held the CPU at 100% (renderlist_10k measured median 0.59-0.61 ms, p95 0.81-0.89 ms in the same minutes, against 0.39-0.42 / 0.45-0.59 idle). 10000 of 10000 sprites visible, 0 culled. The idle run is pending (docs/gates.md, Release bench gates).

rampage_tick_5k.source: The measured p95 with 2x headroom (docs/milestone-specs.md M3c): 2 x 3.109 ms, the median of five runs' p95; the design's tick budget is 1/160 s = 6.25 ms

measured.note: Ranges over 5 runs of 1000 ticks after 50 untimed ones (5000 movers and the player; deterministic: 4995 entities alive at the end, 18 contacts in the last tick). Per-system medians of one run: Cleanup (drain, FinalizeSpawns, world hash) 1.27 ms, Collision 0.91 ms, Path 0.33 ms, Boundary and PrevTransformCopy 0.03 ms each.
